caption: The drawing is a pencil illustration on an off-white or light tan background, depicting a single dark-colored mug with a large, ornate handle on its right side. The mug is cylindrical with a slightly flared lip at the top and a base that is wider than the body, featuring two subtle horizontal lines around its circumference, and a vertical highlight down the center indicating shine. The handle is curved with a decorative swirl near the bottom attachment. In the upper left corner, there are two smaller outlined sketches: one shows an isolated, ornate handle shape and the other shows a simplified version of the mug’s profile with the handle in minimal detail. In the lower right corner, a small rectangle contains a straightforward, simplified side view of the mug with the height "4”" indicated by double-headed arrows. The artist's signature, "Eugene J. Barrell," is present below the main drawing. The composition largely employs grayscale shading to depict the metallic appearance and reflection on the mug’s surface.
title: Pewter Mug
